name: Isle of Man
description: In Isle of Man, public holidays are celebrated throughout the year. These include statutory national holidays, regional observances, and important cultural or religious festivals where businesses and schools may be closed.

sections.title: About Isle of Man Public Holidays
sections.content: Isle of Man observes several statutory and public holidays. Depending on the specific holiday and local regulations, government offices, banks, and many private businesses may close. Some holidays are celebrated on fixed dates, while others are movable and depend on lunar or religious calendars.

faqs.question: How many public holidays does Isle of Man have?
faqs.answer: The exact number of public holidays in Isle of Man can vary from year to year, depending on how movable holidays and weekend substitutions fall on the calendar.
